evidenceLevel: Human-reviewed public summary only; no raw receipts or internal coverage matrix.
packageScope: New audited Windows portable package with a narrowly scoped tray show-all/hide-all repair and session-boundary guards, tested on a disposable cloud runner with isolated local fixtures.

newPackageFindings.D09: Actual native tray show-all and hide-all actions now affect the intended pets correctly, preserve independent identities and obey the display limit. The original tray case is complete.
newPackageFindings.D08: Normal settings controls, real owned-window fullscreen detection, hiding/restoration and independent interaction with both restored pets passed again on this new package.

acceptanceConclusion.comparison: Previously accepted 61 plus newly completed D09. Two original cases were fully exercised on this exact new package; 60 retain exact-version earlier evidence after independent impact review. This does not mean 62 cases were rerun.

impactQualification: Changes are limited to tray visibility commands and their companion/session integration. Earlier evidence retains its original execution versions and limitations; unaffected paths are not described as newly tested.
limitations: One cloud-runner display and owned application windows only. No multi-monitor, cross-DPI, external-game or production-cloud claim. Incomplete cases remain incomplete.
publicationBoundary: Detailed evidence and both versioned matrices remain local. Public traceability uses the existing workflow artifact and its whole-archive checksum.
